summary: The implementation preserves existing principals/ACL/API identities, keeps tenant provisioning operator-only, gates cookie mutations with Origin+CSRF, stores OTP/session/SCIM credentials as hashes, limits full_name to self/admin surfaces, forces Enterprise RLS, and isolates SCIM-owned membership/roles from local state.
residual_risks: Email and SCIM must remain disabled until bootstrap administration and secrets are configured.
Production SMTP, OIDC discovery, and Okta SCIM must be canaried; local evidence does not establish external provider operation.
